svg.title: Domain Model - Buffet Restaurant Management System (baseline 6d83eac)

g.text: Domain Model - Buffet Restaurant Management System (baseline 6d83eac)
Conceptual domain relationships are not reverse JPA collections.
Session owns table/package/soup FK associations; Grant owns session_id.
Opening-price snapshot stays internal to the Billing reader.
PAID and COMPLETED are separate; bill request keeps the session ACTIVE.
openingTargetStock / active planned for Final; absent in baseline 6d83eac.
